entries.title: Firstmate's own small reactions now say a few words too
entries.body: The reactions the app plays by itself now show a few words above the character, like Firstmate's other gestures: "Hello" when the app opens, "Merged" when work is merged, "Noted" when Firstmate keeps a note of yours, and a short description of each bit of idle play, such as "Here’s Orion". A reply's words still wait until Firstmate has finished its turn.

picture.alt: The word Hello above the Firstmate character as the app opens
